final_wiki.answer-Q-4184-A62:
Q-4184: How many days are there from 2024-11-05 to 2024-12-10 (count the end date but not the start date)?

Answer: 35

Calculation:
- November has 30 days. From Nov 5 to Nov 30 (not counting Nov 5, counting Nov 30): 30 - 5 = 25 days.
- From Dec 1 to Dec 10 (counting Dec 10): 10 days.
- Total: 25 + 10 = 35 days.
